context: Filed when the oracle-verdict rename merged (#2843). not_before is 14 days after that merge.
description:
Since #2843 (merged 2026-10-09 20:16 UTC) the oracle posts reviews that open with `### oracle-verdict: <state> for <sha>`. The required checker `_project/scripts/oracle_review_check.py` also accepts the old line through `LEGACY_ORACLE_CONTEXT`, so an open pull request whose latest oracle review predates the rename keeps its result.

Removal condition. Remove the old line from the checker only when no open pull request's latest `benchbox-oracle[bot]` review opens with `### oracle-review-shadow:`. Check it with the GitHub API over every open PR to develop (each PR's reviews, latest by submitted_at). If any still do, re-run the oracle on those PRs (a `/oracle-review` comment or a new push) or wait, and re-check.

Required change. Drop `LEGACY_ORACLE_CONTEXT` from `_ORACLE_VERDICT` in the checker and update test_oracle_review_check.py: the legacy case must now fail. Update docs/operations/oracle-review-v2.md (Decisions and Cut-over) to stop saying the check reads the old line.

Guardrails.
- The soundness merge digest keeps accepting both lines permanently (`ORACLE_VERDICT_LINE` in soundness_merge_digest.py): it reads merged history. Do not touch it.
- The retry-state fallback to `oracle-review-shadow-state-<n>` artifacts in github.py may be removed in the same change only if no open PR still depends on it (its newest state is under the new prefix); otherwise leave it.
- Never weaken the required check otherwise; very-high tier; normal oracle PR flow.
